products.name: DaVinci Resolve AI
products.note: Professional video AI; color grading; facial recognition; local processing option

profile_text.body:
Blackmagic Design is a hardware and software manufacturer founded in 2001 and headquartered in Port Melbourne. The company describes itself as creating products for the feature film, post production, and broadcast industries, with its portfolio spanning digital cinema cameras such as the URSA line, live production switchers under the ATEM brand, the Fairlight audio mixer, storage and networking hardware, and capture and playback devices. Its current product announcements emphasize high-bandwidth connectivity, with many devices built around 100G Ethernet and the SMPTE-2110 IP video standard.

The company's primary AI product is DaVinci Resolve AI, a professional video editing and color grading application that incorporates features including facial recognition and runs with a local processing option. DaVinci Resolve 21 is referenced on the company's site among its latest software releases. The AI capabilities are embedded within a broader professional post-production toolset rather than offered as a standalone AI service.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Blackmagic Design.
